COPY_WORDS:
mov si,0x8000
 mov di,0x9000
 mov cx,16
 rep movsw
FILL_WORDS:
mov di,0x9000
 mov cx,16
 mov ax,0x3939
 rep stosw
SCAN_BYTES:
mov di,0x9000
 mov cx,16
 mov al,0xfe
 repne scasb
COMPARE_WORDS:
mov si,0x8000
 mov di,0x9000
 mov cx,16
 repe cmpsw
DRAW_WORDS:
mov ax,[bx]
 xor ax,0x5555
 rol ax,1
 mov [bx+2],ax
 inc bx
 and bx,0x83ff
CHECKSUM:
mov ax,[bx]
 add ax,[bx+2]
 adc dx,0
 mov [bx+4],ax
 add bx,2
 and bx,0x83fe
BRANCH_SCAN:
test byte [bx],1
 jz $+4
 inc dx
 inc dx
 inc bx
 and bx,0x83ff
STACK_CALL:
push ax
 push bx
 call $+5
 jmp $+4
 inc dx
 ret
 pop bx
 pop ax
ARITH_BRANCH:
mov ax,[bx]
 mov dx,7
 mul dx
 test ax,8
 jz $+4
 inc bx
 dec bx
